settings.label: Slots
settings.help: How many slots a spin shows. All of them alike is the jackpot.

settings.label: Match chance
settings.help: Chance in percent that a spin may land matching slots: they're then drawn freely, so a match is likely but not certain. The rest of the time a repeat is rerolled to avoid a match. The odds below show what really comes out.

settings.label: Jackpot chance
settings.help: Chance in percent that every slot shows the same emote - the jackpot. '1' is 1 in 100. A free draw can land all alike too, so the real chance is a little higher.

settings.label: Rerolls
settings.help: How hard a spin that isn't meant to match avoids a repeat: each slot is drawn up to this many times. A repeat can still slip through, most of all with few emotes in play.

settings.label: Emote pool (0 = all)
settings.help: How many of the emotes in play are drawn for each spin. Fewer emotes make matches more likely. 0, or more than there are, uses them all.

settings.label: Min weight
settings.help: Only emotes with at least this weight play. Low weights come up often and pay little, so raising this takes out the cheapest emotes.

settings.label: Max weight
settings.help: Only emotes with at most this weight play. High weights are rare and pay a lot, so lowering this takes out the most valuable emotes.

settings.label: Default bet
settings.help: The bet for a spin with no amount. Viewers can also bet a number, all, half, third, quarter or random.

settings.label: Minimum (0 = none)
settings.help: The smallest bet allowed. 0 turns the limit off. 'random' bets between Minimum and Maximum. Also applies to channel points in 'Typed amount' and 'Fixed' mode.

settings.label: Maximum (0 = none)
settings.help: The largest bet allowed. 0 turns the limit off. Also applies to channel points in 'Typed amount' and 'Fixed' mode.

settings.label: Free mode
settings.help: Every spin is free: nobody pays or wins points, the jackpot pool doesn't grow, and chat gets the Free messages. For a single free spin, a trigger of your own can pass the argument free=1 instead.

settings.default: points
settings.label: Points variable
settings.help: The variable your points live in. Currency Core by StreamUP and LOYALTY POINTS by tawmae are found on their own; only change this for a points system of your own.

settings.default: Points
settings.label: Shown in chat as
settings.help: The name {currency} puts in chat, like 'Coins' or 'Gems'. Currency Core and LOYALTY POINTS bring their own name, which is used instead.

settings.label: 2 alike
settings.help: A win pays the bet × payout % × the emote's weight ÷ 100, and never less than the bet. All slots alike is the jackpot, which pays the Jackpot tier whatever the number of slots.

settings.label: 3 alike
settings.help: With 3 slots, three alike is the jackpot and this tier is not used.

settings.label: 4 alike
settings.help: Only with 5 or 6 slots; fewer slots never land four alike short of the jackpot.

settings.label: 5 alike
settings.help: Only with 6 slots.

settings.label: Jackpot
settings.help: All slots alike, whatever their number: 3 of 3 as much as 6 of 6.

settings.label: Subscriber boost
settings.help: Gives Twitch subscribers a bigger payout on wins and jackpots. Twitch only: on YouTube and Kick the game doesn't check for subscribers.

settings.label: VIP boost
settings.help: Gives Twitch VIPs a bigger payout on wins and jackpots. Twitch only: on YouTube and Kick the game doesn't check for VIPs.

settings.label: Subscriber boost
settings.help: How much bigger a subscriber's win is: '10' turns 100 into 110. Adds up with the VIP boost for someone who is both.

settings.label: VIP boost
settings.help: How much bigger a VIP's win is: '20' turns 100 into 120. Adds up with the Subscriber boost for someone who is both.

settings.label: Addicted cut
settings.help: How much of an addicted viewer's win is cut, from 0 (nothing) to 99 - a win always pays something. Applied last, so it cuts a boosted win and the jackpot pool too. Who counts as addicted is set on the Access page.

settings.label: Jackpot pool
settings.help: Every lost bet goes into a pool, one per platform, and a jackpot with a big enough bet wins it all on top. Losses of addicted viewers and free spins don't go in. Messages can wrap what they say about the pool in {jackpot}…{/jackpot}: with the pool off, that part is left out.

settings.label: Bet to win the pool
settings.help: The smallest bet that wins the pool with a jackpot. A smaller bet still gets the jackpot payout, just not the pool.

settings.default: twitch
settings.label: Platform
settings.help: Whose emotes the test spin uses: a Twitch emote only exists on Twitch, a Kick emote only on Kick. Subscriber and VIP boosts only exist on Twitch. Not saved.

settings.label: Bet to try
settings.help: A bet to try the odds and messages with. It isn't saved.

settings.default: viewer
settings.label: Spin as
settings.help: Who spins: boosts and the Addicted cut change what a win pays.

settings.label: Spin
settings.help: Plays one spin with the settings as they stand on this page, saved or not, and shows the slots and the message chat would get. Nothing is sent and nothing is saved.

settings.label: Twitch
settings.help: The emote exactly as it's typed in chat, like Kappa, with its weight: a low weight comes up often and pays little, a high one is rare and pays a lot. Its picture appears beside it once it is known to Twitch, 7TV, BTTV or FFZ. Chat only shows it as an emote if the account sending the messages can use it, and a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ one only to viewers with that extension. Which weights play is set on the Game page.

settings.label: YouTube
settings.help: The emoji or text chat gets for this slot, like 🍒, with its weight.

settings.label: Kick
settings.help: Kick shows [emote:ID:name] as the emote. Open the emote's picture in a new browser tab: the number in its address is the ID (https://files.kick.com/emotes/1730803/fullsize is emojiRich).

settings.label: Blocked groups
settings.help: Everyone in these Streamer.bot groups is ignored when they run the command or redeem the reward (Settings > Groups). A group that does not exist is skipped and logged.

settings.label: Addicted viewers
settings.help: These viewers still play, but every win is cut by the Addicted cut on the Game page, their losses don't feed the jackpot pool, and the per-viewer cooldown holds them on channel point redemptions too.

settings.label: Addicted groups
settings.help: Everyone in these Streamer.bot groups counts as addicted.

settings.label: Channel points start a spin
settings.help: On Twitch, a redemption of the reward below spins instead of the chat command, which is then off on Twitch. The slot machine takes redemptions from Twitch only, so on YouTube and Kick the command keeps working.

settings.label: Reward ID
settings.help: The ID of the channel point reward that starts a spin. Other rewards are ignored; without one, no redemption starts a spin. https://ayrtonalexis.com/reward_checker/reward_check.html lists your rewards with their IDs.

settings.default: cost
settings.label: What is bet
settings.help: Reward cost: the reward's price is the bet, paid in channel points; a loss doesn't touch the viewer's points or the jackpot pool, a win is paid in points. Typed amount: viewers type a bet in their own points into the reward, checked against their balance like a chat spin; not enough, and the redemption is refunded. Fixed: every redemption bets the fixed amount below, the price and the text are ignored, the channel points are the stake. Free: nothing is won or lost and the Free messages are used.

settings.label: Fixed bet
settings.help: What every redemption bets in Fixed mode. Must be more than 0.

settings.label: Refund redemptions that don't end in a spin
settings.help: When a redemption can't end in a spin - a blocked group, a bet that doesn't work, an addicted viewer still on cooldown, a balance that can't be read or no emotes - it's cancelled and the channel points go back. That only works while the redemption is still in the request queue: a reward that skips the queue can't be refunded.

settings.label: Everyone
settings.help: How long nobody can spin after any spin, in seconds. 0 turns it off. Saving writes it onto the chat command in Streamer.bot, so channel point redemptions don't wait for it.

settings.label: Per viewer
settings.help: How long one viewer waits before their next spin, in seconds. 0 turns it off. Saving writes it onto the chat command in Streamer.bot, so channel point redemptions don't wait for it - except for addicted viewers, whom the game holds to it itself.

settings.label: Write a log file per day
settings.help: Writes every spin - win, loss, jackpot - with the bet and the balance to a dated 'SMG-log-yyyy-MM-dd.txt' in the Logs folder, one file per day.

settings.default: @{user}, you WON! {amount} {currency}! 🎉🎉{jackpot} (Min. bet for the Jackpool: {jackpotMinBet} {currency}){/jackpot} -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Win
settings.help: Sent after the slots on a win that isn't the jackpot. The slots themselves go out as a message of their own just before.

settings.default: @{user}, you LOST! Better luck next time!{jackpot} 💸 {jackpotLossContribution} {currency} got added to the Jackpool of now {jackpotPoolCurrent} {currency}!{/jackpot} -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Loss
settings.help: Sent after the slots on a loss. With the jackpot pool on, the lost bet goes into it.

settings.default: 🔥 J A C K P O T 🔥 @{user}, YOU WON {amount} {currency}{jackpot} + {jackpotPoolWinAmount} {currency} from the Jackpool!{/jackpot} -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Jackpot
settings.help: Sent after the slots when all of them are alike.

settings.default: 🎉 @{user}, you WON! Lucky spin!
settings.label: Win
settings.help: Sent after the slots on a win while Free mode is on.

settings.default: 💸 @{user}, unlucky! Better luck next spin!
settings.label: Loss
settings.help: Sent after the slots on a loss while Free mode is on. Nothing is taken.

settings.default: 🔥 J A C K P O T 🔥 @{user}, incredible! You hit the jackpot on a free spin!
settings.label: Jackpot
settings.help: Sent after the slots on a jackpot while Free mode is on.

settings.default: @{user}, you WON! {amount} {currency}! 🎉🎉 -- Addiction Fee: your win was cut by {addictedCutPercent}% -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Win
settings.help: Sent instead of the Win message to viewers on the Addicted list.

settings.default: @{user}, you LOST! Better luck next time! 💸 -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Loss
settings.help: Sent instead of the Loss message to viewers on the Addicted list. Their losses don't go into the pool.

settings.default: 🔥 J A C K P O T 🔥 @{user}, YOU WON {amount} {currency}{jackpot} + {jackpotPoolWinAmount} {currency} from the Jackpool!{/jackpot} -- Addiction Fee: your win was cut by {addictedCutPercent}% -- Your new balance: {newBalance} {currency}
settings.label: Jackpot
settings.help: Sent instead of the Jackpot message to viewers on the Addicted list.

settings.default: ❌ @{user}, {reason}
settings.label: Bet refused
settings.help: The frame around the four reasons below; {reason} is replaced by whichever one applies.

settings.default: no decimals, negative, invalid or too large amounts.
settings.label: Reason: not a valid amount
settings.help: Fills {reason} when the amount is negative, not a number, has decimals, or is too large.

settings.default: you don't have enough {currency}.
settings.label: Reason: not enough points
settings.help: Fills {reason} when the bet is more than the viewer has.

settings.default: your bet is below the minimum ({min} {currency}).
settings.label: Reason: below the minimum
settings.help: Fills {reason} when the bet is below the minimum on the Game page.

settings.default: your bet is above the maximum ({max} {currency}).
settings.label: Reason: above the maximum
settings.help: Fills {reason} when the bet is above the maximum on the Game page.

settings.default: Please wait '{seconds}' seconds before trying again ⏳
settings.label: Everyone's cooldown
settings.help: Sent while the cooldown for everyone runs.

settings.default: @{user}, please wait '{seconds}' seconds before trying again ⏳
settings.label: A viewer's cooldown
settings.help: Sent while this viewer's own cooldown runs.

settings.default: @{user}, your Channel Points were refunded since the redemption couldn't be completed.
settings.label: Refunded
settings.help: Sent when a redemption is refunded.
